name: riptide-extension
description: Riptide download manager — browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Firefox (Manifest V3)

scripts.build: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs chrome && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs firefox && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs firefox
